customer_name: Ted Taylor (independent Schlotzsky's and Cinnabon franchisee)
business_problem: Operating three co-branded restaurants required time-consuming work across menu pricing, labor analysis and scheduling, cash reconciliation, payroll, policies, and supply or repair requests.
solution_summary: Ted Taylor applies ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work across three co-branded Schlotzsky's and Cinnabon restaurants. He supplies local competitor pricing, menu prices, sales history, and supplier prices to ChatGPT Work for analysis and item-level price recommendations; the page does not identify a separate ingestion or storage platform. For labor oversight, he grants read-only access to sales and labor data so the assistant can compare scheduled, budgeted, and actual hours with sales forecasts and 12 weeks of history, then return a report highlighting overtime and coverage gaps. The manager reviews a generated schedule, adjusts it, and enters it in the restaurant scheduling system. For monthly cash reconciliation, Taylor uploads store transaction data and bank records for matching; the assistant returns analysis for human review. ChatGPT is also used to draft policies, summarize payroll inputs, and build a request portal for supplies and repairs.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Helps Taylor research, draft restaurant policies, and complete day-to-day back-office tasks.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Work
solution_components.role: Analyzes restaurant pricing, sales, labor, payroll, and cash records and produces recommendations, reports, and schedules.

data_flow: Taylor provides competitor pricing, menu and sales history, supplier prices, labor data, transaction records, and bank records to ChatGPT Work. It returns pricing recommendations, labor reports, schedules, and reconciliation analyses for human review; managers enter approved schedules into the restaurant scheduling system.
business_outcome: Taylor cut analysis and back-office task time, made monthly reconciliation and payroll work faster, and used recommendations to identify potential labor savings and cash flow improvements while retaining human review before implementation.
